meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

copy.tagline: 通过高强度提问打磨你的方案或设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在落地前发现计划中的漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen your plan or design through relentless questioning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to uncover flaws in your plan before execution

howto.what: 当你执行 /grilling 命令时，Claude 会发起一场严格的面试式对话，通过不断提问来帮你完善计划或设计。
howto.when: 在对话中输入 /grilling 命令时触发。

say.text: 开始一个grill-me会话，帮我打磨我的创业计划。
say.note: 启动面试模式，Claude会追问你的计划细节。

say.text: 请用grill-me模式审查我的产品设计方案。
say.note: 让Claude严格审视设计的每个环节。

howto.what_en: When you run the /grilling command, Claude starts a relentless interview-style session that asks probing questions to sharpen your plan or design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /grilling in the conversation.

say_en.text: Start a grill-me session to sharpen my startup plan.
say_en.note: Initiates the session; Claude will ask detailed questions.

say_en.text: Review my product design under grill-me mode.
say_en.note: Claude scrutinizes every aspect of the design.
